ticker_news.title: Corporate Buybacks: A Wolf In Sheep’s Clothing?
ticker_news.description: Corporate buybacks have become a controversial topic, with critics arguing they primarily benefit insiders rather than shareholders. The article explores the mechanics of buybacks, their impact on markets, and whether they truly return capital to shareholders or merely enrich executives.
ticker_news.author: Lance Roberts

ticker_news.title: S&P 500: Downside Volatility Ahead? Odds of Medium-Term Corrective Move Rise
ticker_news.description: The S&P 500 has reversed down by 3% from its all-time high, and market breadth indicators have deteriorated, suggesting a potential medium-term corrective decline ahead of the US presidential election.
ticker_news.author: Marketpulse

ticker_news.title: What Nvidia Stock Investors Should Know About Meta Platforms' Earnings
ticker_news.description: The article discusses Nvidia's stock performance in relation to Meta Platforms' earnings. It also mentions that billionaires John Overdeck and David Siegel are investing in Nvidia, while reducing their holdings in a Warren Buffett favorite.
ticker_news.author: Jose Najarro

SPY.title: Stocks Rebound After Selloff As October Hiring Slump Fuels Interest Rate Cut Bets: 10 ETFs To Watch Friday
SPY.description: Stocks rebounded after Thursday's decline as a hiring freeze in October boosted market expectations for Federal Reserve rate cuts. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF, and other sector-specific ETFs saw gains.
SPY.author: Piero Cingari, Benzinga Staff Writer
